campuses.title: Putrajaya Green Campus
campuses.text: Главный кампус Heriot-Watt Malaysia — первый сертифицированный green campus в стране, lakeside-расположение в административной столице Malaysia. School of Engineering, School of Mathematical and Computer Sciences, Edinburgh Business School.

campuses.title: Campus locations
campuses.text: Our campuses in Edinburgh, Scottish Borders and Orkney each offer bespoke facilities and a distinctive learning environment.

paragraphs: Heriot-Watt University Malaysia is the Putrajaya campus of Heriot-Watt University, one of Scotland's oldest universities (founded 1821 in Edinburgh). The Malaysia campus opened in September 2014 with £35 million invested in a purpose-built facility, making it the first certified green campus in Malaysia.

Located in Precinct 5 of Putrajaya — Malaysia's federal administrative centre — the campus sits on a 1.9-hectare lakeside plot and offers undergraduate and postgraduate degrees identical in award to those issued by Edinburgh. Graduates receive a UK degree from Heriot-Watt University.

The campus operates four academic units mirroring Edinburgh: School of Engineering and Physical Sciences, School of Mathematical and Computer Sciences, School of Energy, Geoscience, Infrastructure and Society, and Edinburgh Business School. Flagship programmes include Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Actuarial Science, Computer Science and the MBA.

International students come from over 50 countries. The campus is around 25 km from Kuala Lumpur and 20 minutes from Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA), making it convenient for travel and weekend access to Malaysia's capital.
paragraphsRu: Heriot-Watt University Malaysia — кампус Heriot-Watt University в Putrajaya, одного из старейших университетов Шотландии (основан в 1821 в Edinburgh). Кампус в Малайзии открылся в сентябре 2014 года с инвестициями £35 миллионов в purpose-built здание — это первый сертифицированный green campus в Malaysia.

Расположен в Precinct 5, Putrajaya — федеральном административном центре Malaysia — кампус занимает 1.9 гектара у озера и предлагает бакалаврские и магистерские степени, идентичные дипломам Edinburgh. Выпускники получают UK-диплом от Heriot-Watt University.

Кампус включает четыре академических подразделения, повторяющих Edinburgh: School of Engineering and Physical Sciences, School of Mathematical and Computer Sciences, School of Energy, Geoscience, Infrastructure and Society, и Edinburgh Business School. Флагманские направления — Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Actuarial Science, Computer Science и MBA.

Международные студенты приезжают из более чем 50 стран. Кампус расположен в 25 км от Kuala Lumpur и в 20 минутах от Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA) — удобно для путешествий и выездов в столицу на выходные.
